org.xtrudecad.XtrudeCAD.finish-args-home-filesystem-access: Open Recent reopens files by path, and importers read files next to the chosen one (an OBJ's .mtl material library), which a portal grant for the single chosen file does not cover.
org.xtrudecad.XtrudeCAD.finish-args-contains-both-x11-and-waylan: The user can choose X11 in a Wayland session (Preferences > Display > Graphics server), and the app restarts itself under X11 when Wayland gives no GPU context; fallback-x11 would hide the X11 socket in both cases.
